tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Public plans and add-ons with prices in USD (one-time and monthly), what each includes and excludes, and the page to buy it. Omit plan_id to get everything.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Services this business provides, each with a description and the URL of its page. Omit tag to get all.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Email, phone, WhatsApp and the booking link for a free 15-minute diagnostic call. Omit channel to get all.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Published blog posts about GoHighLevel, AI automation and marketing, newest first. Paginate with next_cursor.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, get_contact_options, list_posts · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, get_contact_options, list_posts · Private data: get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
